mof_risk_snapshot_2024_12_30.interpretation: Maturity and refixing remain distinct observed concepts. The two-percentage-point total-debt gap at this snapshot alone rules out treating the maturity share as the refixing share.

eurostat_external_diagnostic_2025.definition: accrual interest expenditure divided by average outstanding Maastricht debt

gate_1_ledger_completeness.reason: Public instrument terms and issue sizes do not provide same-date opening outstanding principal or realized repriced/reset principal for the full MoF cost boundary. Coverage cannot be manufactured by treating issue size, redemption schedules or financing needs as the missing stock/event principal.

gate_2_balance_reconciliation.reason: Gate 1 failed; no definitionally matched instrument/block principal can be summed against the MoF published stock.

gate_3_portfolio_cost_reconstruction.reason: The ledger does not contain the opening principal and effective old rate for at least 95% of the matched portfolio, nor matched new/reset rates for at least 90% of repricing-event principal. Published 2019-2023 portfolio costs therefore cannot be reconstructed without prohibited allocation.

gate_4_parameter_identification.reason: No matched event-level principal/old-rate/new-rate blocks exist in the public ledger subset. An aggregate m would absorb unobserved instrument, currency and fixed/floating structure.

gate_5_prospective_confirmation_for_vali.reason: Historical reconstruction did not reach CANDIDATE eligibility.

estimation.reason: The prospective completeness gate failed. Running an estimator would necessarily convert missing public debt structure into synthetic allocation.

what_is_reconciled: instrument identity, currency, fixed coupon, maturity and issue-size/terms for a reproducible public subset of Ministry of Finance securities
new issuance/reopening terms are kept semantically separate from refinancing and contractual refixing
MoF risk snapshots preserve separate maturity and refixing measures rather than collapsing them
MoF portfolio-average cost observations remain reference targets with their original boundary
Eurostat Maastricht apparent cost and currency shares are retained as external diagnostics only, not mixed into the MoF cost equation
what_remains_unidentified: full matched opening outstanding principal by instrument/currency/fixed-floating under the MoF cost boundary
realized principal refinanced in each period linked to the maturing block it replaces
contractual reset dates and realized repriced principal for floating/indexed debt
old effective rate and new/reset effective rate on the same repriced principal
same-boundary interest-cost decomposition sufficient to reproduce published MoF portfolio cost within the frozen tolerance

next_justified_path.primary: Prospective monetary confirmation when a genuinely new BNR policy-rate movement supplies identifying variation; until then the frozen household form and reserved observations remain untouched.
next_justified_path.government_data_path: Continue only if an official/reproducible source becomes available that supplies same-date outstanding principal plus matched reset/refinancing rates across the material MoF portfolio boundary. Repeating aggregate proxy fitting is not justified.
